summary: Cytek Biosciences filed an 8-K reporting a jury verdict in a patent infringement lawsuit brought by Beckman Coulter. The jury found in Cytek's favor on three of four claims (noninfringement/invalidity) but found infringement under the doctrine of equivalents on one claim, awarding $20M lost profits and $36.11M royalties. Cytek intends to pursue post-trial motions and possibly appeal. This is a litigation update, not a special situation.
